report_identity.report_title: TAKBO GROUP HOLDINGS LIMITED Annual Report 2024

business_overview.one_sentence: The group designs, develops, manufactures and sells beauty products, and designs, develops and sells beauty bags.

segments.name: Beauty products
segments.source: 2024 annual report MD&A p.6 / segment note p.119

segments.name: Beauty bags
segments.source: 2024 annual report MD&A p.6 / segment note p.119

business_overview.revenue_model: Export-oriented contract/customer product sales; 2024 revenue came mainly from the UK, USA and other overseas markets, with manufacturing assets mainly in the PRC.
business_notes: Revenue fell 13.3% in 2024 and gross margin fell from 35.0% to 31.8%; management attributed the drop to US tariff-related customer shift and diversification toward the UK market.
Major customers are concentrated: Customer B, A and D in beauty products and Customer A in beauty bags each exceeded 10% of 2024 revenue.

gaps: No detailed schedule splitting cash by legal entity beyond the parent company balance sheet and currency/location disclosures; subsidiary extraction is therefore haircut rather than assumed at par.
No explicit restricted cash line was found; the analysis relies on no pledged assets plus cash/deposit notes, and still reserves necessary operating cash.
Maintenance versus growth capital expenditure is not separately disclosed; 2024 PPE plus intangible purchases are treated conservatively in cash-profit quality.
